info.title: SmartCity Backend API
info.description: REST API for managing public buildings and energy devices in a smart city

put.summary: Update energy consumption of a building
put.description: Updates the energy consumption value and unit for a specific public building identified by its UUID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the public building whose consumption is to be updated.

requestBody.description: The new energy consumption value and unit to assign to the building.

200.description: Energy consumption updated successfully for the specified building.

400.description: Invalid request data, such as a negative consumption value or an unsupported energy unit.

example.message: Validation failed: consumption value must be non-negative.

404.description: No public building found with the provided UUID.

example.message: Public building with id 'a3f1c2d4-5e6b-7890-abcd-ef1234567890' was not found.

patch.summary: Update energy consumption of a building
patch.description: Updates the energy consumption value and unit for a specific public building. The building must exist and the provided consumption data must be valid.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the public building whose consumption is to be updated

requestBody.description: New energy consumption value and unit to assign to the building

204.description: Energy consumption updated successfully. No content is returned.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity — The consumption value or unit is semantically invalid (e.g., negative consumption value or unsupported energy unit).

example.message: Consumption value must be greater than or equal to zero.

400.description: Bad Request — The request body is malformed or contains missing required fields.

404.description: Not Found — No public building exists with the provided identifier.

example.message: Public building with id 'a3f1c2d4-5e6b-7890-abcd-ef1234567890' was not found.

409.description: Conflict — The consumption update conflicts with the current state of the building (e.g., concurrent modification detected).

example.message: Building consumption was modified by another request. Please retry.

post.description: Registers a new public building in the smart city system. Only accessible by administrators. Returns the UUID of the newly created building.

201.description: Public building successfully created. The response body contains the UUID of the new building.

422.description: Business rule violation. The request is well-formed but contains invalid domain data, such as a duplicate building name or an unsupported energy unit.

400.description: Malformed or invalid request payload. Required fields may be missing or contain values that fail validation constraints.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of public buildings registered in the smart city system. Optionally filter by energy eligibility status.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

parameters.name: eligible
parameters.description: When set to true, returns only buildings eligible for energy production programs. When false, returns only ineligible buildings. Omit to return all buildings.

200.description: A paginated list of public buildings successfully retrieved.

post.summary: Add an energy device to a building
post.description: Registers a new energy device (e.g. solar panel, wind turbine, battery) and associates it with the specified public building. Returns no content on success.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the public building to which the device will be added

204.description: Device successfully added to the building. No content is returned.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity — the request body is syntactically valid but contains semantic errors, such as an unsupported device type or invalid energy unit combination.

example.message: Device type 'UNKNOWN' is not supported for energy tracking.

400.description: Bad Request — one or more required fields are missing or fail validation constraints (e.g. null device name, negative capacity value).

404.description: Not Found — no public building exists with the provided identifier.

example.message: Public building with id '3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6' was not found.

409.description: Conflict — a device with the same identifier or name already exists within this building.

example.message: A device named 'Rooftop Solar Panel A' already exists in building '3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6'.

patch.summary: Update production rate of a device
patch.description: Updates the energy production rate of a specific device installed in a public building. Only devices capable of producing energy (e.g., solar panels) can have their production rate modified.

parameters.name: buildingId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the public building that contains the device

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the energy-producing device to update

204.description: Device production rate updated successfully. No content is returned.

422.description: The provided production value or unit is semantically invalid (e.g., negative production value or unsupported energy unit).

example.message: Production value must be greater than zero

400.description: The request body is malformed or contains invalid field values (e.g., missing required fields or incorrect data types).

example.message: Invalid request: productionValue must not be null

404.description: The specified building or device was not found. Either the buildingId does not correspond to an existing public building, or the deviceId does not exist within that building.

example.message: Device with id '7cb94e21-1a3b-4d8e-9f02-abc123def456' not found in building '3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6'

409.description: A conflict occurred while updating the device production rate, such as a concurrent modification to the same device.

example.message: Conflict: device production rate was modified by another request

get.summary: Get a public building by ID
get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific public building, including its energy consumption and associated devices, identified by its unique UUID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the public building to retrieve.

200.description: The public building was found and its details are returned successfully.

404.description: No public building was found with the specified ID.

example.message: Public building with id '3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6' was not found.

delete.description: Permanently removes a public building and all its associated devices from the system. Only administrators are authorized to perform this operation.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the public building to delete.

204.description: The public building was successfully deleted. No content is returned.

404.description: No public building was found with the specified ID.

example.message: Public building with id 'a3f1c2d4-5e6b-7890-abcd-ef1234567890' does not exist.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all registered public buildings in the smart city, including their energy consumption details and associated devices.

200.description: A list of all public buildings was successfully retrieved.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new JWT + new refresh token
post.description: Accepts a valid refresh token and issues a new short-lived JWT access token together with a rotated refresh token. The previous refresh token is invalidated immediately after use. Use this endpoint to silently renew a session without requiring the user to re-enter credentials.

requestBody.description: The refresh token previously issued during login or a prior token refresh.

200.description: Token refresh successful. Returns a new JWT access token and a rotated refresh token. The client should replace both stored tokens immediately.

post.summary: Revoke the current JWT and its refresh token
post.description: Invalidates the provided JWT access token and its associated refresh token, effectively ending the user's session. After a successful logout, the tokens can no longer be used to authenticate requests.

requestBody.description: The refresh token to be revoked along with the current JWT session.

200.description: Tokens successfully revoked. The user's session has been terminated and the provided JWT and refresh token are no longer valid.

post.summary: Authenticate and receive a JWT + refresh token
post.description: Validates the provided credentials and, on success, returns a signed JWT access token along with a refresh token that can be used to obtain new access tokens without re-entering credentials.

requestBody.description: User credentials required to authenticate and obtain tokens.

200.description: Authentication successful. Returns a signed JWT access token and a refresh token for the authenticated user.

post.summary: Register a new account with email and password
post.description: Creates a new user account using the provided email and password. On successful registration, returns an authentication token that can be used for subsequent authenticated requests.

200.description: Account successfully created. Returns authentication credentials including an access token.

delete.summary: Remove an energy device from a building
delete.description: Removes a specific energy device from a public building. Once removed, the device will no longer contribute to the building's energy consumption or production tracking. Requires ADMIN role.

parameters.name: buildingId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the public building from which the device will be removed.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the energy device to be removed from the building.

204.description: The energy device was successfully removed from the building. No content is returned.

404.description: The specified building or device was not found. Either the buildingId does not correspond to an existing public building, or the deviceId does not correspond to a device registered under that building.

example.message: Device with id 'b7e2d3f5-6a7c-8901-bcde-f01234567891' not found in building 'a3f1c2d4-5e6b-7890-abcd-ef1234567890'

ChangeConsumptionRequest.description: Request payload for updating the energy consumption value and unit of a city asset.

consumptionValue.description: The new energy consumption value for the asset. Must be zero or a positive number.

consumptionUnit.description: The unit of energy measurement corresponding to the consumption value.

CreateBuildingRequest.description: Request payload for creating a new building asset in the smart city system.

name.description: The unique human-readable name of the building.

location.description: The physical address or geographic location of the building.

AddDeviceRequest.description: Request payload for adding a new device to an asset, specifying the device type and its rated energy capacity.

type.description: The type of device being added to the asset.

ratedCapacityValue.description: The numeric value of the device's rated energy capacity. Must be a positive number.

ratedCapacityUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the device's rated energy capacity.

ChangeProductionRequest.description: Request payload for updating the energy production value and unit of an asset

productionValue.description: The new energy production value for the asset. Must be zero or positive.

productionUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the energy production value.

EnergyDeviceResponse.description: Represents an energy device asset with its rated capacity and production rate specifications.

id.description: Unique identifier of the energy device.

type.description: The category of the energy device (e.g., solar panel, pump, or battery storage).

ratedCapacityValue.description: The maximum power capacity the device is rated to handle, expressed in the corresponding unit.

ratedCapacityUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the rated capacity value.

productionRateValue.description: The current or nominal rate at which the device produces or consumes energy, expressed in the corresponding unit.

productionRateUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the production rate value.

PublicBuildingResponse.description: Represents a public building asset in the smart city, including its energy consumption details and associated energy devices.

id.description: Unique identifier of the public building.

location.description: Physical address or geographic location of the public building.

consumptionValue.description: Current energy consumption value of the building, expressed in the unit specified by consumptionUnit.

consumptionUnit.description: Unit of measurement for the building's energy consumption (kilowatts, megawatts, or gigawatts).

devices.description: List of energy devices installed in the public building that contribute to or monitor its energy consumption.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response returned when a request fails, containing error details and diagnostic information.

errorCode.description: Application-specific error code identifying the type of error.

message.description: Human-readable description of the error that occurred.
message.example: Asset with ID 42 was not found in the system.

status.description: HTTP status code associated with the error.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp indicating when the error occurred.

requestId.description: Unique identifier for the request, useful for tracing and debugging in logs.

RefreshRequest.description: Request payload for refreshing an access token using a valid refresh token

refreshToken.description: The refresh token previously issued during authentication, used to obtain a new access token

LoginResponse.description: Response returned upon successful authentication, containing the JWT access token, user role, token expiry duration, and a refresh token.

token.description: JWT access token to be included in the Authorization header for subsequent requests.

role.description: Role assigned to the authenticated user, determining their access level within the system.

expiresInMs.description: Duration in milliseconds until the access token expires, starting from the time of issuance.

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token used to obtain a new access token once the current one has expired, without requiring re-authentication.

LogoutRequest.description: Request payload for logging out a user by invalidating the provided refresh token

refreshToken.description: The refresh token to be invalidated upon logout

LoginRequest.description: Credentials used to authenticate a user. The username field accepts either a plain username (for pre-seeded admin/viewer accounts) or an email address (for self-registered users).

username.description: The account identifier: either a plain username (e.g. 'admin', 'viewer') or the email address used during self-registration.

password.description: The account password associated with the given username or email.

PagedResponsePublicBuildingResponse.description: A paginated response containing a list of public building records along with pagination metadata.

content.description: The list of public building records returned for the current page.

totalElements.description: The total number of public building records across all pages.

totalPages.description: The total number of pages available based on the page size.

pageSize.description: The number of public building records returned per page.

RegisterRequest.description: Request payload for registering a new user account.

email.description: A valid, unique email address that will be used as the user's login identifier.

password.description: The account password. Must be at least 8 characters long.
